visualCharacteristics: Two-column intro layout: left cell holds a large heading, a subheading paragraph, and two CTA buttons; right cell holds a vertical stack of three images. Sits on a grey (secondary) section.
contentPattern: Row 1 (left): heading + paragraph + two links (CTAs). Row 1 (right): three stacked images.
usage: Use at the top of a page as a hero-style intro pairing a text/CTA column with a group of images.
